_source.title: 使用鼠标放置封装
_source.remarks.text.0: 本接口模拟前端点击放置按钮，指定的封装将绑定到当前鼠标，并在用户后续点击时放置于画布
_source.remarks.text.1: 本接口的返回时机并不会等待用户的放置操作，一旦封装被绑定到鼠标，本接口将立即返回 `true` 的结果

title: Place with the mouse footprint
remarks.text.0: This API simulates clicking the placement button on the front end. The specified footprint will be bound to the current mouse and placed on the canvas when the user clicks subsequently
remarks.text.1: The return timing of this API does not wait for the user's placement operation. Once the footprint is bound to the mouse, this API will immediately return `true`
